title: Conditional kappa 0.00310184 (+1.39e-6 over updated #5599): compose the shared relay and helper splits
body:

The complete conditional endpoint is **kappa 0.00310184**. Its raw crossing is **(0.00310184254783, 0.00310184254784)**; the claim is tested at 0.0031018405.

The consumed #5599 head `0644592d421b375c221045954fdf13932575ffa8` claims 0.00309839, so the historical comparison receipt shows a gain of 0.00000345. During verification, #5599 independently composed with #5565 and advanced to 0.00310045 at `09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137`. This result is **0.00000139 above that updated claim**. Immutable consumed inputs remain explicitly pinned; the selected frontier is unchanged.

The cascade removes the line visits required by original splits 12 and 15. Those splits and their credits are omitted. Every remaining rational prefix/suffix witness is checked again on the evolving combined word; merely adding headline improvements would overcount. The complete bill has **66,690 paid calls, 13,048 productive targets and rank surplus 760**. The local word has **748 independent inputs, 540 helpers, eight owned lifetimes, peak one and 25,502 events**.
